note: SYNTHETIC simulator data - not a measurement from a real vehicle

items.name: Monitor status since DTCs cleared (MIL, DTC count)

observed_capabilities.fan_activity: manual annotations only: no generic OBD signal reports the radiator fan

recording.post_scan_skipped: recording ended with the link in state 'ecu_unresponsive'; no request is sent to an unresponsive ECU

label: engine_started
note: engine speed rose above the running threshold (measured RPM)

label: engine_stopped
note: engine speed fell to ~0 while the ECU kept answering (measured RPM). The session stays open: mark fan_running / fan_stopped and ignition_off when they happen.

label: ecu_communication_lost
note: The ECU stopped answering while the adapter link was up. This is NOT proof that the ignition was switched off. Vehicle polling is paused (sleeping modules are not polled or woken); only the adapter supply voltage is read.
